dimensions.note: The new swamp-serve-token kind holds no secret: the schema refuses `secret`/`secretRef` on it, and the probe never touches the vault (audit test asserts zero vault reads). `swamp access token list --json` returns metadata only (name, principal, state, createdAt, expiresAt, lastUsedAt -- verified live); parseServeTokenList keeps just name/state/effectiveState/expiresAt and never echoes raw stdout into a detail. A `subject` containing `.` (a pasted `<name>.<secret>` token) is refused before anything is written, and the detail does not repeat it.
No new log lines: the existing per-entry `{id}: {status}` line and the entry/summary lines cover the new kind. Nothing from the listing is logged.

readServeTokenList never throws: a missing binary, a timeout (AbortSignal.timeout), a non-zero exit (stderr capped at 300 chars) or unparseable output is a listing `detail`, which the probe reports as `unreachable` -- a statement about the monitor, kept distinct from authFailed. An empty array parses as zero tokens, so each entry reports its token missing (authFailed) rather than passing. Absent token or a non-active effectiveState is authFailed; past expiresAt is expired regardless of state.

12 new tests (96 total): ok/missing/revoked/expired/null-expiry/unparseable-listing paths of the probe, subject validation incl. a pasted token, listing parse refusals and field filtering, the CLI argv incl. --repo-dir and both failure modes via an injected CommandRunner, the schema's no-secret rule, and an audit-level test asserting one listing for two entries and no vault reads.
Read-only. The listing is memoized per audit run only, so every run reads a fresh listing.

The contract is the swamp CLI's JSON listing, validated as an array of rows with a string name before any field is read; non-string fields degrade to empty/null and are classified, never trusted. No pagination: the listing returns every token (3 rows live, 0.8 s).

One subprocess per audit at most, stdin null, stdout/stderr collected by output(), killed by AbortSignal.timeout(timeoutMs). The only Deno.Command is marked swamp-quality-ignore with a justification: fixed argv apart from the configured swampBin/swampRepoDir, and no swamp primitive exposes token metadata to a model.
Fixtures and README use fictional token names (report-bot, old-bot, ...) and placeholder paths (/srv/repo, /srv/swamp-repo). No hostnames, IPs or fleet identifiers.
CredentialInputSchema moves from .refine to .superRefine so the secret rule can depend on kind; still a plain z.object, no passthrough. Two new global args with defaults.
Unchanged: both specs lifetime infinite, garbageCollection 30.
A read-only monitor with a single audit method; no lifecycle to manage.
No mutating method. The existing id preflight still runs and covers the new kind.
Unchanged: one credential instance per normalised id plus `current`, guarded by preflight.
The method does not read back stored state.
2026.10.20.2 adds an upgrades entry; resource schemas are unchanged (the credential `kind` enum gains a value), so upgradeAttributes is the identity.
